description: This file defines a configuration class for Google Image Generation API integration within a larger image generation framework. It includes methods for parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing specific to Gemini and other Imagen models.

classes.name: GoogleImageGenConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Google Gemini image generation API, including parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns supported OpenAI parameters for Google API.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Google Gemini API parameters.

methods.name: _map_size_to_aspect_ratio
methods.description: Converts size strings to aspect ratio strings.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on model and environment.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates API key presence and sets required headers.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_request
methods.description: Transforms prompt and parameters into Gemini-specific request format.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_response
methods.description: Parses Gemini or other Imagen model responses into internal ImageResponse format.
